value.text: {"sql": "SELECT to_date(from_utc_timestamp(to_timestamp(hr_utc, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), 'America/Chicago')) AS local_day, hour(from_utc_timestamp(to_timestamp(hr_utc, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), 'America/Chicago')) AS peak_hour_cdt, MAX(usgs_northport_peak_cfs) AS max_peak_cfs FROM water.hourly_compare WHERE hr_utc BETWEEN '2026-10-18 06:00' AND '2026-10-25 06:00' AND usgs_northport_peak_cfs IS NOT NULL GROUP BY local_day, peak_hour_cdt ORDER BY local_day, peak_hour_cdt", "purpose": "Confirm the CDT hour of the daily maximum 15-min peak at USGS Northport for Oct 18–24"}
